stages.name: Dip foundation
stages.work: Dip negatives (3 s) → band-assisted parallel dips → bodyweight; sternum and strict pull-ups; false-grip hangs; hollow and arch holds; bar support

exercises.name: Parallel bar dips (band or BW)
exercises.cue: Lower until shoulders break 90°, then lock out. Lean forward 15°, elbows tucked.
exercises.note: Use a band until you can do 6 clean reps.

exercises.name: Straight-bar support hold
exercises.cue: Jump on, lock elbows, push shoulders down into depression.

exercises.name: Hollow body hold
exercises.cue: Lower back glued flat to the floor, ribs tucked toward pelvis.

exercises.name: Parallel bar 3-second dip negatives
exercises.cue: Jump to top, lower agonisingly slow over 3 full seconds. Fight hardest at the bottom.

exercises.name: Strict dead-hang pull-ups
exercises.cue: Overhand. Chin clearly over bar, full elbow lockout at the bottom.

exercises.name: High sternum pull-ups
exercises.cue: 100% intent, C-curve arc to the lower sternum. Stop the set immediately if rep height drops.

exercises.name: Band-assisted straight-bar dips
exercises.cue: Lean chest over the bar, touch lower ribs.

exercises.name: False-grip bar active hangs
exercises.cue: Deep palm-crease grip, shoulder blades pulled down.

exercises.name: Floor arch-to-hollow snaps
exercises.cue: Rocking between superman and hollow. Sharpens the core whip for the transition arc.

stages.name: Straight-bar crossing
stages.work: Straight-bar dip negatives (5 s), Russian dips, false-grip top holds, low-bar turnovers, speed chest-to-bar, L-sit chins, hanging toes-to-bar

exercises.name: Straight-bar dip negatives
exercises.cue: Jump to the top with the bar at your lower ribs, then lower slowly for a full 5 seconds.
exercises.note: Start at 3 s and add a second at a time until 5 s is smooth.

exercises.name: Russian dips (parallel bars)
exercises.cue: Lower, lean forward until your forearms rest on the bars, then press back up.
exercises.note: Hard on the elbows and wrists. Warm the wrists up first and stop a set when the lean gets sloppy.

exercises.name: L-sit chin-ups
exercises.cue: Legs straight out in front, level with your hips, and chin clearly over the bar.
exercises.note: Tuck your knees if your legs start to drop.

exercises.name: Hanging toes-to-bar
exercises.cue: Straight legs, lift from your abs, and lower under control without swinging.
exercises.note: Do knee raises until straight legs are possible.

exercises.name: False-grip top holds
exercises.cue: False grip, chin over the bar with your wrists resting on top, shoulders pulled down.
exercises.note: Jump or step up to the top if you cannot pull there. Build from 5 s to 10 s.

exercises.name: Speed chest-to-bar pull-ups
exercises.cue: Pull as fast as you can and touch your chest to the bar. Stop the set when your speed drops.

exercises.name: Low-bar turnovers
exercises.cue: Pull the bar to your lower ribs, then roll your chest over it fast.
exercises.note: Use a bar at about hip height with your feet on the floor. Use your legs as much as you need, a little less each week.

exercises.name: Floor arch-to-hollow snaps
exercises.cue: Rock fast between a superman arch and a tight hollow.

stages.name: Banded integration
stages.work: Band-assisted muscle-ups (heavy → light band), 6 s negative muscle-ups, explosive and weighted dips, lockout and L-sit holds
ready: Clean single with a light band

exercises.name: Weighted parallel bar dips

load.text: Light belt or vest, about 2 reps left in the tank

exercises.cue: Same clean dip as before: shoulders below your elbows, then full lockout.
exercises.note: Add weight only when all 4 sets are clean, and keep the jumps small.

exercises.name: 6-second negative muscle-ups
exercises.cue: Jump to the top above the bar, then lower slowly back through the turn for 6 seconds.
exercises.note: Hard on the elbows. Skip the set if an elbow or wrist is sore.

exercises.name: Chest-to-bar pull-ups with a pause
exercises.cue: Pull until your chest touches the bar, hold for a second, then lower all the way.

exercises.name: Parallel bar L-sit hold
exercises.cue: Arms locked, shoulders pushed down, legs straight and level.
exercises.note: Tuck your knees if you cannot hold straight legs.

exercises.name: Straight-bar lockout hold
exercises.cue: Chest over the bar, arms locked, shoulders pushed down.

exercises.name: Band-assisted muscle-ups

load.text: Heavy band, then lighter as the reps get clean

exercises.cue: Pull to your lower ribs, turn over fast, and press to lockout.
exercises.note: Go to a lighter band only when all 4 sets are clean. The standard is one clean rep with a light band.

exercises.name: Explosive dips
exercises.cue: Lower in control, then press up as fast as you can to a full lockout.

exercises.name: False-grip chest-to-bar pull-ups
exercises.cue: False grip, pull fast to your chest and keep your wrists on top of the bar.

stages.name: Micro-band → unassisted
stages.work: Micro-band singles, unassisted attempts, neural primers

exercises.name: 6-second negative muscle-ups
exercises.cue: Jump to the top above the bar, then lower slowly back through the turn for 6 seconds.
exercises.note: Hard on the elbows. Skip the set if an elbow or wrist is sore.

exercises.name: Weighted parallel bar dips

load.text: Light belt or vest, about 2 reps left in the tank

exercises.cue: Shoulders below your elbows, then full lockout.
exercises.note: Keep the weight where it is. This is upkeep, not a push.

exercises.name: Chest-to-bar pull-ups with a pause
exercises.cue: Pull until your chest touches the bar, hold for a second, then lower all the way.

exercises.name: Hollow body hold
exercises.cue: Lower back glued flat to the floor, ribs tucked toward your pelvis.

exercises.name: False-grip bar active hangs
exercises.cue: Deep palm-crease grip, shoulder blades pulled down.

exercises.name: Explosive sternum pull-ups (primer)
exercises.cue: Two fast reps to your lower chest, then rest. Stay fresh for the attempts.

exercises.name: Micro-band muscle-ups
exercises.cue: Same turn as the real thing, with the band only helping a little.
exercises.note: Go to a thinner band, or none, when all 3 singles feel easy.

exercises.name: Strict unassisted muscle-up attempts
exercises.cue: No band, no big kip. Pull to your lower ribs, turn over, and lock out.
exercises.note: This is the test. Stop the session if your pulling speed drops or an elbow or wrist complains.
